notes: Fixed a black console window that could flash up on screen during a hardware scan.

Cause: to find which games are installed, the app runs the Windows registry tool reg.exe. That one call was missing the flag that hides the console. NovaPanel's main process is a windowed program with no console of its own, so Windows…
Added a new build check that fails the build if any helper program is started without hiding its window, so this cannot come back. It is checked on every build alongside the existing four checks.

Note in the interest of accuracy: the flash could not be reproduced under observation - 175 seconds of watching for a visible console window, both idle and through a full hardware scan, caught none. This fixes the one call that was…
